protocol.architecture: Unchanged CausalGraphQueue hidden32/use_graphTrue,13slots/9channels,6speed+6queue outputs. Identical initialization per seed across3arms.
protocol.warmup: scratch0;event_warm/dense_warm400steps batch8,AdamW.001/wd1e-4/clip1,same all6step posweight4BCE+.1L1speed. Event population balanced bycondition;dense uniform all5minute legal FIT origins. Data/sampling differ,not claimed pure architecture gain.
protocol.finetune: All3arms800steps batch4,identical per-seed balanced-event batches and original event loss. Reset optimizer before common fine-tune. Preserve actual exposures and batch arrays.
protocol.checkpoint: Existing15day buffer event metadata;fresh legal input/teacher reconstruction,minimum condition/window Brier at200/400/600/800. Analytic weighted-BCE odds correction only,no fitted probability calibration.
protocol.decision: Existing30days. Frozen strong tree vs3seed-means,eachfixed.75tree+.25NN;complete-domain threshold calibration. Preferincumbent/scratch/event_warm/dense_warm in tie;individualseeds diagnostics,never primary choices.
protocol.inputs: Pure indexed<=T history/rawpast12 plus published maskedT;future labels/speed/quality loss/evaluation only. Dense history-only condition proxy differs from selection guarantee,then event finetune.
protocol.scope: Previously viewed public observation-proxy development dates,not latent/final/private. No new formal score/submission/platform operations;finalsim seeds unopened.
